body.input: [T10a image-attach] Describe the attached image briefly. NOTE: on models without native vision, the attachment reaches you as an injected vision DESCRIPTION inside the message - that injected description IS the image content and counts as seeing it. End your reply with STEP_OK if image content (native or injected description) is present and you described it, or FAILED: <reason> only if NO image content of either form is present.
